slides.heading: Simple List Project
slides.body: Simple List Project is part of Lists and Mutable Sequences. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Simple List Project
slides.body: A simple list project combines creating, updating, appending, and looping through list values.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A list project is like managing a small task board where you can add, change, and review items.

annotations.note: This line stores or updates a value using a variable.
This line adds a new item to the end of the list.
This line displays a value or message on the screen.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Lists use square brackets, zero-based indexes, and can be changed after creation.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Create a to-do list, append one new task, then print each task.
slides.hint: Use append(), then a for loop to print each item.
